newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian MP expelled for criticizing minister.
newsitem.headline: Canadian MP expelled for criticizing minister.

text.p: Opposition politician Chuck Strahl was kicked out of Parliament for the day on Wednesday for accusing Defence Minister Doug Young of covering up what has become known as the Somalia affair.

House of Commons Speaker Gilbert Parent ordered Strahl barred from the House for the rest of the day after he criticised Young for ordering an end to an inquiry over Canada's peacekeeping in Somalia and its aftermath.
Strahl referred to harsh words the head of the inquiry, Justice Gilles Letourneau, had at a news conference on Wednesday regarding Young's order to wrap up proceedings by the end of March.

"I got kicked out for saying exactly what the ... justice said. By shutting down the inquiry, they risk a whitewash," Strahl told reporters after leaving the chamber, flanked by other members of his Reform Party.

Strahl's words, uttered during the House's daily Question Period, were: "Justice Letourneau said that he (Young) and the prime minister both knew ahead of time that shutting down the inquiry would result in a cover-up and a whitewash."
Reform members have been highly critical of House rules, charging that members who lie are not punished but members who accuse colleagues of lying are.
While Strahl was speaking to reporters, a shouting match over the affair began in the parliamentary lobby between two other Reform members of Parliament and a Liberal member.
The Somalia inquiry is looking into the behaviour of the now-disbanded Canadian Airborne Regiment in 1993, at whose hands a Somali teenager was tortured and murdered.

The Liberal government was not in power then, but some have accused defence officials then of trying to cover up the affair and have subsequently accused and Young and his Liberal colleagues in doing the same in the inquiry.
Former Conservative Prime Minister and Defence Minister Kim Campbell says she wants to tell her side of the story but the inquiry says it will not have time.
